# F1 full-height candidate: coordinated window test

G1 recorded119 consecutive DNGs with3032×2020 RAW,3000×2000 crop,12bits and24fps, matching the patched geometry and frame-size callback. This validates the short cropped recording, not full-height acquisition. F1 is the first full-height candidate built on that result.

The18-word guarded RAM patch retains mode151 identity and true24 timing. It changes profile429's six dimension words (already tested by G1), adds RAW ratios2048 in both axes, copies three full-height dimensions and geometry+0x54 from stock mode3, copies four differing words in the56-byte receiver record from mode3, and changes the input-window coordinates in two packed timing-record words. See firmware/fullheight-f1-plan.json for every address, expected value, replacement and reason. No sensor table byte changes are needed: all161 programmed register values for151 already match native full-height modes3 and121; the trailing fixed CE/D1/D2/D3 writes were separately verified previously.

New finding: changing the100-byte geometry and32-byte timing records alone is insufficient. The56-byte receiver record atC0B5D438 also retains the cropped input window and receiver flags. C0320AB0 selects the record by mode ID throughC0320F60, andC032D5E0 constructs two driver configurations. F1 copies every differing non-ID word of native mode3's record. Field semantics beyond observed native configurations are not assumed. The40-byte auxiliary record remains stock with the16:9 preview; it is not a RAW pixel-buffer allocation table. FunctionsC03205F8 andC0320700 expose this auxiliary configuration, and its hardware semantics are only partly traced.

New verifier tools/verify_fullheight_capture.py executes native C0321290 (mode indices), C0320740 (timing), C0320008 (input window) and C0320AB0 (receiver setup) with the hardware-captured UHD sensor object. It substitutes only singleton lookup and hardware-driver endpoints, records their arguments, and guards writes to the object/stack. Four cases: stock151, native3, native121, F1-modified151. Both F1 input-window configurations exactly match native3: class3,x8..6072,y40..4082. Both68-byte receiver configurations exactly match native3. Timing remains HMAX445,VMAX6740 andtail1145, or3,000,000 cycles/frame (24fps at the upstream72MHz sensor clock). No delay, sensor, receiver, DMA or concurrent mode-switch behavior is modeled by these comparisons.

At ratio2048,6064×4042 maps arithmetically to3032×2021; the requested RAW3032×2020 has even origin0,0. The visible crop is3000×2000 at16,10, corresponding approximately to the normal6000×4000 active image. Bayer phase, precise optical coverage and reducer filtering still require hardware images. Keeping sensor sampling enums unchanged is not proof that every photosite contributes to the reduced Bayer output. Do not claim that quality goal has been met.
